caption: The drawing is a black-and-white line illustration depicting a decorative cast iron balcony railing. The composition shows the front view of the balcony set against a brick wall, which is partially rendered on both the left and right sides. The railing consists of five vertical panels, each adorned with ornate patterns. The lower sections of the panels feature symmetrical scrollwork with spiral and floral motifs centered around pointed finials, while the midsections feature a sunburst or star-shaped design. Each panel is topped with additional decorative flourishes, and the railing spans the space between the two segments of the brick wall. Horizontal lines suggest the top railing bar and the base, which is situated above an area textured to indicate a different material, possibly stone or masonry. At the bottom of the drawing, the text "CAST IRON BALCONY RAILING" is written in uppercase letters, with a measurement of "39''" indicated vertically to the left side of the railing. The entire drawing is executed with fine, detailed black lines on an off-white background.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Railing
